I'm so glad we decided to meet up here, it's been too long. How was your Christmas, Mum? Ah, it was lovely, dear. We had all the family over, as usual. It's so great to see you, Dad! It's been ages. How have you been? Ah, it's great to see you too, son! I've been doing all right, just been keeping busy with work and whatnot. You know how it is. I'm so excited to start knitting that bean bag cover this weekend. I've got all the yarn and needles ready to go. Ah, that's a great project! I'm telling you, it's been a right old struggle to get the garden sorted out. I've been at it for weeks. Oh, come on, dear. You're not still moaning about the garden, are you? Isn't it lovely walking along the Thames? You can see so many famous landmarks. Yes, it's great. I love the view of the O2 Arena from here. It's so impressive. I know, I was just thinking that.
